detail.description:
Latitude and longitude are approximate. Put-in appears to be where Wyckoff Road crosses Schoharie Creek. The run ends at the reservoir of Mine Kill State Park. This section of the Schoharie connects Schoharie Reservoir to Mine Kill Reservoir.
